description.value: Grama's Inn is a family-owned and operated motel in Prince George, BC that has been in continuous operation for over 50 years. With 60 recently renovated rooms and suites — including pet-friendly rooms, kitchen suites, and accessible rooms — it serves a wide range of travellers from solo visitors to large sports teams and bus tours. An on-site restaurant, guest laundry, and meeting and banquet facilities make it a self-contained base in the city.

address.value: 901 Central Street West, Prince George, BC V2M 3C8

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is active and contains recent promotions (Christmas 2025-2026 special), confirming the business is open. Contact details on the website (901 Central Street W, Prince George, BC V2M 3C8; tel 250.563.7174; info@gramasinn.com) match OSM tags exactly. No mention of bike-specific storage, bike handling procedures, or bike-in-room policies anywhere on the site; the site does explicitly confirm guest laundry, vending machines, free parking, and complimentary Wi-Fi, and the on-site Grama's Kitchen restaurant serves breakfast daily.
concerns: Website contains an undated notice that 'Grama's Kitchen has reopened for patio and takeout service April 30, 2021', suggesting some page content has not been updated since 2021; current specials referencing Christmas 2025-2026 confirm the business remains active.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating, family-owned motel in Prince George with an active website, confirmed contact details, and a range of amenities useful to touring cyclists passing through the region.
